recalculation.notes: These are direct static-DFT stresses/pressures; no experimental pressure gauge or calibration scale exists.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the final typeset MSA article. The conventional-cell conversion and BM3 convention reproduce the vector-digitized Figure 2c curve.

primary_source_check.finding: The source reports one static-LDA standard BM3 for exact NaMg2Al5SiO12 NAL. It does not publish coefficient uncertainties, covariance, or the underlying numerical DFT grid.

primary_data_check.finding: All six visible current-study markers were extracted from PDF vector geometry. Earlier-study comparison markers were excluded.

numerical_reproduction.finding: The digitized curve independently confirms equation order, volume basis, and rounded coefficients. The refit is diagnostic only because the original grid and fitting protocol are not published.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Calculated states/theory determine this EOS; source: structure-model discussion, pages 305-307; Figure 2c and caption, page 307; first-principles details and Table 1, page 308.
parameter_provenance.equation: Results, page 308: calculated volumes were fitted with a third-order Birch-Murnaghan equation; the formula is not printed, so Peritheos uses the standard Eulerian BM3 convention verified against Figure 2c.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 1: 35.8 cm3/mol. Figure 2c is exactly three times this scale, establishing a silent four-oxygen normalization. Multiplication by three and division by 0.602214076 cm3 mol-1 per A3 gives 178.34189581447112 A3 for the Z=1 12-O conventional cell.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table 1, NAL (NaMg2Al5SiO12): B0'=4.08; no fixed qualifier is printed.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: Methods: every structure was fully relaxed to a static (0 K) configuration.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: All six visible current-study NAL circles in Figure 2c are retained. The paper does not state whether its fit used one configuration, every configuration, or configuration-averaged volumes; differences are described only as small.

source_lineage.role: published EOS coefficients, plotted pressure-volume curve, composition, and calculation protocol
